description: This file defines API routes for analytics related to customer purchases, dashboard statistics, and sales aggregation in a FastAPI application. It contains endpoint functions for retrieving frequent customer purchases, dashboard stats including outstanding balances, best buyers, and top products.

methods.name: frequent_purchases( limit: int = Query(10, description="Number of customers"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customers with the most invoices, limited by the provided limit parameter.

methods.name: get_dashboard( db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Gathers dashboard statistics including outstanding customers, the top buyer, and the top products by sales amount.

ctags.name: frequent_purchases
ctags.signature: ( limit: int = Query(10, description="Number of customers"), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
